Topics covered in this PDF

MPSE-011 (European Union in World Affairs) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Neo-Functionalism and intergovernmentalism, the European Commission and Parliament, co-decision and qualified majority voting, the Maastricht, Amsterdam and Nice Treaties, national approaches to integration
  • Economic and Monetary Union, foreign and security policy integration, India-EU relations, regionalism in Europe and South Asia, the Common Agricultural Policy, the Cecchini Report

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The PDF carries no cover question-paper preview, so the marks scheme and word limits are not printed in it. The course title is taken from the existing Hindi page for this code and is not printed in the PDF. Ten questions are printed with their answers; Q10 has two short notes.

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

How to use the solved PDF properly

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:

  • First read your official assignment paper and choose the questions you must answer
  • Learn the answer structure from the PDF: introduction, concept or facts, examples and conclusion
  • Write your final answer in your own words. The university alone evaluates it
  • Use the first 3 page preview to check the PDF's layout and typing before you buy
